meetings.title: Hosted at Capital Group symposium
meetings.summary: Patricia Caldwell and Joseph Moreau from Meridian Aerospace Pension Trust attended a conference hosted by Capital Group. They discussed the progress of their current mandates and explored potential new opportunities. The meeting concluded with an agreement to prepare a fee proposal for the Capital Group Growth mandate.

decisions.text: Prepare a fee proposal for the Capital Group Growth mandate

action_items.text: Review and finalize the proposal by next week

transcript_excerpt.speaker: Patricia Caldwell
transcript_excerpt.text: I'm glad to see you all here today. We've been doing well with our existing mandates, but I think there are some exciting opportunities on the horizon.

transcript_excerpt.speaker: Joseph Moreau
transcript_excerpt.text: Absolutely, Patricia. The Capital Group Growth mandate seems like a great fit for us given our current portfolio.

meetings.title: Annual portfolio review completed
meetings.summary: The meeting was held to review the annual portfolio performance of Meridian Aerospace Pension Trust. The Capital Group International Equity mandate and the Capital Group Growth (US Equity) mandate were discussed, with both in the Due Diligence stage. Patricia Caldwell provided insights on the trust's investment strategy and objectives, while Joseph Moreau offered updates on the progress of the ongoing mandates.

decisions.text: Continue due diligence on the Capital Group International Equity mandate to finalize the decision by Q4.
Schedule a peer benchmarking session with other institutional clients in April for comparative analysis.

action_items.text: Prepare and present the peer benchmarking data to Patricia Caldwell by end of April.
Finalize the decision on the Capital Group International Equity mandate based on due diligence findings.

transcript_excerpt.speaker: Patricia Caldwell
transcript_excerpt.text: We've had a great year with the Capital Group International Equity mandate. It's performing well against our benchmarks.

transcript_excerpt.speaker: Joseph Moreau
transcript_excerpt.text: I'm pleased to report that the Capital Group Growth (US Equity) mandate is also in good shape, and we're making progress on due diligence.

meetings.title: Strategy due-diligence meeting
meetings.summary: The Meridian Aerospace Pension Trust held a strategy due-diligence meeting with Patricia Caldwell and Joseph Moreau. The discussion focused on the Capital Group Growth mandate, which is currently in the Due Diligence stage. Both participants expressed interest in peer benchmarking data to support their decision-making process.

decisions.text: Share peer benchmarking data with Meridian Aerospace Pension Trust

action_items.text: Prepare and present peer benchmarking data to Patricia Caldwell and Joseph Moreau by the end of next week.

transcript_excerpt.speaker: Joseph Moreau
transcript_excerpt.text: I think we should definitely look into sharing peer benchmarking data to get a better understanding of how our strategy stacks up against competitors.
